Implemented a dependency-free Rust (2021) RS274/NGC simulator as a standard Cargo project under `output/`.

- Build/run: `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` and `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <file> --output <json>`
- Supports all required/optional CLI flags from the prompt, including tool/parameter files, block delete, probing (`--probe-box`/`--probe-tool`), and trace output with `--trace-time-step` / `--trace-distance-step` / `--trace-position-tolerance`.
- Implements simulation + JSON output and trace generation per the specified schemas (and now writes `--output`/`--trace-output` JSON on errors as well).
- Key implementation lives in `output/src/rs274.rs` (parser/files) and `output/src/sim.rs` (execution, probing, canned cycles G81–G89, trace stepping).

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
